1use crate::common::Result;
2use crate::{Exceptions, Point};
3
4use super::RegressionLineTrait;
5
6#[derive(Clone)]
7pub struct RegressionLine {
8    points: Vec<Point>,
9    direction_inward: Point,
10    pub(super) a: f32,
11    pub(super) b: f32,
12    pub(super) c: f32,
13    // std::vector<PointF> _points;
14    // PointF _directionInward;
15    // PointF::value_t a = NAN, b = NAN, c = NAN;
16}
17
18impl Default for RegressionLine {
19    fn default() -> Self {
20        Self {
21            points: Default::default(),
22            direction_inward: Default::default(),
23            a: f32::NAN,
24            b: f32::NAN,
25            c: f32::NAN,
26        }
27    }
28}
29
30impl RegressionLineTrait for RegressionLine {
31    fn points(&self) -> &[Point] {
32        &self.points
33    }
34
35    fn length(&self) -> u32 {
36        if self.points.len() >= 2 {
37            Point::distance(*self.points.first().unwrap(), *self.points.last().unwrap()) as u32
38        } else {
39            0
40        }
41    }
42
43    fn isValid(&self) -> bool {
44        !self.a.is_nan()
45    }
46
47    fn normal(&self) -> Point {
48        if self.isValid() {
49            Point {
50                x: self.a,
51                y: self.b,
52            }
53        } else {
54            self.direction_inward
55        }
56    }
57
58    fn signedDistance(&self, p: Point) -> f32 {
59        Point::dot(self.normal(), p) - self.c
60    }
61
62    fn distance_single(&self, p: Point) -> f32 {
63        (self.signedDistance(p)).abs()
64    }
65
66    fn reset(&mut self) {
67        self.points.clear();
68        self.direction_inward = Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 };
69        self.a = f32::NAN;
70        self.b = f32::NAN;
71        self.c = f32::NAN;
72    }
73
74    fn add(&mut self, p: Point) -> Result<()> {
75        if self.direction_inward == Point::default() {
76            return Err(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE);
77        }
78        self.points.push(p);
79        if self.points.len() == 1 {
80            self.c = Point::dot(self.normal(), p);
81        }
82        Ok(())
83    }
84
85    fn pop_back(&mut self) {
86        self.points.pop();
87    }
88
89    fn setDirectionInward(&mut self, d: Point) {
90        self.direction_inward = Point::normalized(d);
91    }
92
93    fn evaluate_max_distance(
94        &mut self,
95        maxSignedDist: Option<f64>,
96        updatePoints: Option<bool>,
97    ) -> bool {
98        // let maxSignedDist = if let Some(m) = maxSignedDist { m } else { -1.0 };
99        let maxSignedDist = maxSignedDist.unwrap_or(-1.0);
100        let updatePoints = updatePoints.unwrap_or_default();
101
102        let mut ret = self.evaluateSelf();
103        if maxSignedDist > 0.0 {
104            let mut points = self.points.clone();
105            loop {
106                let old_points_size = points.len();
107                // remove points that are further 'inside' than maxSignedDist or further 'outside' than 2 x maxSignedDist
108                // auto end = std::remove_if(points.begin(), points.end(), [this, maxSignedDist](auto p) {
109                // 	auto sd = this->signedDistance(p);
110                //     return sd > maxSignedDist || sd < -2 * maxSignedDist;
111                // });
112                // points.erase(end, points.end());
113                points.retain(|&p| {
114                    let sd = self.signedDistance(p) as f64;
115                    !(sd > maxSignedDist || sd < -2.0 * maxSignedDist)
116                });
117                if old_points_size == points.len() {
118                    break;
119                }
120                // #ifdef PRINT_DEBUG
121                // 				printf("removed %zu points\n", old_points_size - points.size());
122                // #endif
123                ret = self.evaluate(&points);
124            }
125
126            if updatePoints {
127                self.points = points;
128            }
129        }
130        ret
131    }
132
133    fn isHighRes(&self) -> bool {
134        let Some(mut min) = self.points.first().copied() else {
135            return false;
136        };
137        let Some(mut max) = self.points.first().copied() else {
138            return false;
139        };
140        for p in &self.points {
141            min.x = f32::min(min.x, p.x);
142            min.y = f32::min(min.y, p.y);
143            max.x = f32::max(max.x, p.x);
144            max.y = f32::max(max.y, p.y);
145        }
146        let diff = max - min;
147        let len = diff.maxAbsComponent();
148        let steps = f32::min(diff.x.abs(), diff.y.abs());
149        // due to aliasing we get bad extrapolations if the line is short and too close to vertical/horizontal
150        steps > 2.0 || len > 50.0
151    }
152
153    fn evaluate(&mut self, points: &[Point]) -> bool {
154        let mean = points.iter().sum::<Point>() / points.len() as f32;
155
156        let mut sumXX = 0.0;
157        let mut sumYY = 0.0;
158        let mut sumXY = 0.0;
159        for p in points {
160            // for (auto p = begin; p != end; ++p) {
161            let d = *p - mean;
162            sumXX += d.x * d.x;
163            sumYY += d.y * d.y;
164            sumXY += d.x * d.y;
165        }
166        if sumYY >= sumXX {
167            let l = (sumYY * sumYY + sumXY * sumXY).sqrt();
168            self.a = sumYY / l;
169            self.b = -sumXY / l;
170        } else {
171            let l = (sumXX * sumXX + sumXY * sumXY).sqrt();
172            self.a = sumXY / l;
173            self.b = -sumXX / l;
174        }
175        if Point::dot(self.direction_inward, self.normal()) < 0.0 {
176            // if (dot(_directionInward, normal()) < 0) {
177            self.a = -self.a;
178            self.b = -self.b;
179        }
180        self.c = Point::dot(self.normal(), mean); // (a*mean.x + b*mean.y);
181        Point::dot(self.direction_inward, self.normal()) > 0.5
182        // angle between original and new direction is at most 60 degree
183    }
184
185    fn evaluateSelf(&mut self) -> bool {
186        let mean = self.points.iter().sum::<Point>() / self.points.len() as f32;
187
188        let mut sumXX = 0.0;
189        let mut sumYY = 0.0;
190        let mut sumXY = 0.0;
191        for p in &self.points {
192            // for (auto p = begin; p != end; ++p) {
193            let d = *p - mean;
194            sumXX += d.x * d.x;
195            sumYY += d.y * d.y;
196            sumXY += d.x * d.y;
197        }
198        if sumYY >= sumXX {
199            let l = (sumYY * sumYY + sumXY * sumXY).sqrt();
200            self.a = sumYY / l;
201            self.b = -sumXY / l;
202        } else {
203            let l = (sumXX * sumXX + sumXY * sumXY).sqrt();
204            self.a = sumXY / l;
205            self.b = -sumXX / l;
206        }
207        if Point::dot(self.direction_inward, self.normal()) < 0.0 {
208            // if (dot(_directionInward, normal()) < 0) {
209            self.a = -self.a;
210            self.b = -self.b;
211        }
212        self.c = Point::dot(self.normal(), mean); // (a*mean.x + b*mean.y);
213        Point::dot(self.direction_inward, self.normal()) > 0.5
214        // angle between original and new direction is at most 60 degree
215    }
216
217    fn a(&self) -> f32 {
218        self.a
219    }
220
221    fn b(&self) -> f32 {
222        self.b
223    }
224
225    fn c(&self) -> f32 {
226        self.c
227    }
228}

230impl RegressionLine {
231    pub fn with_two_points(point1: Point, point2: Point) -> Self {
232        let mut new_rl = RegressionLine::default();
233        new_rl.evaluate(&[point1, point2]);
234        new_rl
235    }
236    pub fn with_point_slice(points: &[Point]) -> Self {
237        let mut new_rl = RegressionLine::default();
238        new_rl.evaluate(points);
239        new_rl
240    }
241}
